title: Pelosi, Omar join Trump and Schiff as unlikely alliance pushes to onshore key industry
summary: Adam Schiff, Nancy Pelosi and Ilhan Omar back Donald Trump's federal film tax incentive to bring movie production back to California and America.

title: Trump commutes sentence for former Philadelphia union official, attorney says
summary: Former union official John Dougherty's lawyer George Bochetto confirmed to Fox News Digital that President Donald Trump commuted Dougherty's sentence.

title: Former Trump Cabinet official had 'inappropriately close' relationship with bodyguard, IG finds
summary: Lori Chavez-DeRemer allegedly ordered a security agent to throw cash at a stripper during an Oregon trip, a Department of Labor OIG report says.

title: Trump administration proposes stripping tax-exempt status from schools using race-based programs
summary: The Trump administration proposed new regulations to strip the tax-exempt status of private schools if ​they offer targeted programs supporting specific racial groups.

title: Missouri high court blocks GOP-backed congressional maps ahead of midterms; Trump blasts 'ridiculous' ruling
summary: The Missouri Supreme Court unanimously blocked the GOP-drawn map, and President Donald Trump called the ruling "ridiculous" before November's vote.

title: Excavation set to begin on Trump administration's 250-foot triumphal arch amid legal battle
summary: Doug Burgum announced the start of excavation on the 250-foot Great Triumphal Arch in Washington, D.C., but a lawsuit challenges the project's authorization.

title: Smithsonian showdown intensifies as Trump administration issues a stark new warning
summary: The Smithsonian Institution faces threats beyond its $1 billion federal funding as Trump administration claims evidence of antidiscrimination violations.

title: White House rips ‘activist’ Biden judge who upended Trump birthright citizenship order
summary: A Biden-appointed judge blocked President Donald Trump's birthright citizenship executive order, calling it "almost certainly unconstitutional."

title: ICE officer pleads not guilty to lying about Minneapolis shooting involving Venezuelan man
summary: Video evidence allegedly contradicted the ICE officer's claims about the Minneapolis shooting of Venezuelan man Julio Cesar Sosa-Celis, prosecutors say.

title: Robot dog could deliver your next package and an ad
summary: Robot.com's R-dog uses articulated legs and wheels to climb stairs and deliver packages, while its built-in screens display paid ads along the route.
